meta.source: lab/rooms_corpus_extract.js and lab/rooms_corpus_stats.js on compact.json (2,128 builds)
meta.likedRule: top quarter of vanilla builds by votes (votes >= 10), ties by downloads
meta.families: track A catalog (data/catalog/pieces.json family, version 1); prefabs it does not list have no family
meta.roomRule: reader room (lib/decorate.js readLevel) with half or more of its floor under a roof, 4 to 400 m2, vanilla build, no mod piece inside; floor furniture: pivot under 0.5 m over the floor

fields.buildKinds: share of the rooms by the kind of building (category and title words)
fields.cultures: culture of the build where data/culture-corpus/members.json sorts it, [culture, rooms]
fields.area: m2, quantiles (n, p10, p25, p50, p75, p90)
fields.shortSide: m, the room box short side along its main wall direction
fields.focal: share of rooms by focal piece (the first of the kind's focal list found)
fields.counts: per type: has (share with one or more), mean, p50, p90, max per room, p50_when and p90_when among rooms that have it
fields.countsLiked: the same for rooms in liked builds
fields.seatKinds: share of floor seats by kind
fields.seatsFacingFocal: seats not at a table within 8 m of the focal: distance quantiles, and the share turned within 30 degrees of the most common turn for that seat prefab (mostCommonTurn: degrees between the seat yaw and the bearing to the focal, in 30 degree steps)
fields.bedHeadToWall: m from the head end to the nearest wall face behind it
fields.chestToWall: m from a chest's back (pivot less half its depth) to the nearest wall face
fields.stackedChests: chests and barrels in the room standing on another (0.4 m across, 0.45 to 1.6 m higher): rooms with storage, share of them with a stack, share of storage pieces stacked, stacked pieces per room when any
